section_text.fc_note: Fintech analogue: take-rate (revenue ÷ GTV ≈ 0.20%) + GTV growth + MDR + the P/E the market grants. Revenue CAGR matters less than whether the take-rate holds as PA + cross-border volume scales. Base 25% tracks FY25 +28.5% then sustains on PA/PG/cross-border licences + affordability, not device sales alone.
section_text.insight: Key insight: the EPS spread (-₹1.25 → ₹12.21, from losses) is wider than the price spread (₹142 → ₹698, ~4.9×). Here the earnings do the heavy lifting — from a loss base. A Bear EPS at Base multiple (₹1.97 × 45× ≈ ₹89) still trails a Base EPS at Bear multiple (₹5.97 × 35× ≈ ₹209) — take-rate and margin first, re-rating second.— Method note: watch GTV→revenue conversion, not just GTV.
